Payer: Lakeshore Medicaid Partners [payer.name]
Denial Reason: CO-50 - Non-covered service; medical necessity not established [denial.reason_code]

We request reconsideration and reversal of the denial to allow payment of this claim.

The claim was denied for lack of medical necessity under the payer's policy requiring 6 or more weeks of failed conservative care prior to coverage [D3]. At the time of service on 2025-06-18, the clinical record documents symptom duration of 1 week with no documented trial of conservative treatment [D2]. The procedure was performed before the policy's documented threshold for coverage was satisfied. We respectfully ask that Lakeshore Medicaid Partners reconsider this denial in light of the clinical circumstances and any additional clinical records that may support medical necessity. We are available to provide further documentation if needed.

records.letter:
**Appeal of Claim Denial**

**Claim ID:** DN-15965 [claim.denial_id]
**Procedure Code:** 29881 [claim.procedure_codes]
**Service Date:** 2025-10-21 [claim.service_date]
**Payer:** Bluewater Mutual Insurance [payer.name]
**Denial Reason:** CO-50 – Not deemed medically necessary [denial.reason_code]

We respectfully request that Bluewater Mutual Insurance reconsider and reverse the denial of this claim.

The claim was submitted for a medically necessary procedure performed on a member under an active policy with Bluewater Mutual Insurance. The provider was credentialed in network at the time of service [D2]. The service was performed on the stated service date and submitted within the filing deadline [claim.service_date][claim.submitted_date].

We recognize that prior authorization documentation was not obtained before the service date [D4][D6]. This represents a procedural error on the provider's part that we acknowledge. However, we request reconsideration of the medical necessity determination, as the procedure itself was clinically appropriate for the member's condition.

We welcome the opportunity to provide additional clinical documentation to support medical necessity and ask that Bluewater Mutual Insurance review this appeal for possible payment. We remain available to submit further records as requested.
